MYSTERIOUS_BLUE_MAP.title: Blue Map
MYSTERIOUS_BLUE_MAP.description: Reveals the positions of secret and super-secret rooms. Bomb a wall to enter them.
MYSTERIOUS_BLUE_MAP.flavor: Two impossible rooms appear on the paper.
MYSTERIOUS_COMPASS.title: The Compass
MYSTERIOUS_COMPASS.description: Reveals special rooms on the map, including shops, rest sites, treasure, elites, and bosses.
MYSTERIOUS_BOGO_BOMBS.title: Bogo Bombs
MYSTERIOUS_BOGO_BOMBS.description: Bomb pickups give twice as many bombs, including room drops and shop purchases.
MYSTERIOUS_PYROMANIAC.title: Pyromaniac
MYSTERIOUS_PYROMANIAC.description: When your bombs explode, heal 5 HP for each bomb.
MYSTERIOUS_IPECAC.title: Ipecac
MYSTERIOUS_IPECAC.description: Damage to one enemy splashes for half as much to other enemies. Each trigger has a 10% chance to deal 10 unblockable damage to you. Area attacks roll for self-damage once.
MYSTERIOUS_IPECAC.flavor: One bitter bite fills the room with explosions.
MYSTERIOUS_SACRED_HEART.title: Sacred Heart
MYSTERIOUS_SACRED_HEART.description: On pickup, gain 10 max HP and heal to full. Deal 25% more damage to enemies.
MYSTERIOUS_WAFER.title: The Wafer
MYSTERIOUS_WAFER.description: Damage from enemies to you is halved. Ipecac's self-damage is unaffected.
MYSTERIOUS_WAFER.flavor: A thin layer between you and disaster.
MYSTERIOUS_HOLY_MANTLE.title: Holy Mantle
MYSTERIOUS_HOLY_MANTLE.description: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Buffer to prevent the next HP damage.
MYSTERIOUS_NINE_VOLT.title: 9 Volt
MYSTERIOUS_NINE_VOLT.description: Gain 1 extra energy on the first turn of each combat.
MYSTERIOUS_NINE_VOLT.flavor: Just enough for one more move.
MYSTERIOUS_HALO.title: The Halo
MYSTERIOUS_HALO.description: On pickup, gain 7 max HP. Gain 5 Block on the first turn of each combat.
MYSTERIOUS_HALO.flavor: A warm glow above your head.
MYSTERIOUS_DATAMINER.title: Dataminer
MYSTERIOUS_DATAMINER.description: Arm in a treasure room, shop, or elite reward screen to transform the next claimed or purchased relic into a glitched relic. No recharge is needed. Later uses add effects to your existing glitched relic.
MYSTERIOUS_DATAMINER.flavor: Dig into the code and see what falls out.
MYSTERIOUS_GLITCHED_RELIC.title: Glitched Relic
MYSTERIOUS_GLITCHED_RELIC.description: Each Dataminer use adds 3–8 random links. Repeated links stack with no total cap. Distinct links remain one-to-one, one-to-two, or two-to-one; matched events always activate.
MYSTERIOUS_GLITCH_POOL_NOTE.label: Generated cards can come from your character, any character, or a named character; potions use your character's pool. Good and bad outcomes can appear. Repeated links stack; feedback stops after 5 triggers. Standard maps have no bombs.
